verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt (404) and no root docs.md (404). However, individual Marqeta doc pages were retrieved at markdown URLs (e.g. /docs/core-api/cards.md, /docs/core-api/introduction.md), which suggests per-page markdown docs an agent could read. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, a root markdown docs entry point, explicit first-party documentation of agent-oriented doc formats, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
